job.job_description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyones contributions and do whats right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
Position Overview
The Senior SAP GenAI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting AI-powered business solutions across McCormicks SAP landscape. This role leverages SAP Business AI, SAP AI Core, SAP AI Foundation, SAP Build Code, SAP BTP, and modern Generative AI technologies to deliver intelligent business capabilities, workflow automation, conversational experiences, and agentic AI solutions.
The position works across SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, and other SAP applications to embed AI capabilities into business processes and business applications.
The Senior SAP GenAI Engineer provides technical expertise in agentic AI systems design and development, SAP AI innovation, and the integration of large language models (LLMs) within the SAP ecosystem. The role collaborates closely with Enterprise Architecture, Responsible AI, Product Teams, and Business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and production-ready AI solutions aligned with enterprise standards and SAP Clean Core principles.
Key Responsibilities
Design, build, deploy, and support Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions leveraging SAP AI Core, AI Foundation, SAP BTP, Joule, and SAP Build Code.
Develop AI agents, orchestration workflows, and autonomous business process solutions using modern agent frameworks and SAP BTP services.
Design and implement integrations between SAP platforms and internally provisioned enterprise AI services and approved foundation models.
Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions utilizing SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Vector Engine, enterprise knowledge repositories, and structured business data sources.
Build reusable AI frameworks, APIs, prompts, agent capabilities, accelerators, and development standards to enable scalable adoption of AI capabilities.
Support solution troubleshooting, prompt optimization, performance tuning, monitoring, and continuous improvement activities for AI-enabled applications.
Research emerging SAP AI and Agentic AI capabilities and contribute to innovation initiatives, proof-of-concepts, and pilot programs.
Secondary Responsibilities
Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture and Responsible AI teams to ensure alignment with enterprise standards.
Participate in technical design reviews and architecture discussions.
Contribute reusable frameworks, libraries, accelerators, and development standards.
Support proof-of-concepts and innovation initiatives.
Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing across SAP development and integration teams.
Create and maintain technical documentation, development standards, and operational runbooks.
Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Responsible AI, Cybersecurity, and Product teams to ensure adherence to established enterprise standards.
Perform other responsibilities as assigned by the Supervisor.
Required Qualifications
Level of Education and Discipline
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related technical discipline.
Certification and/or Licenses
SAP BTP Certification
SAP Certified Associate - SAP Generative AI Developer
Experience - functional/industry/commercial knowledge, business acumen
6-8 years of experience in SAP ERP products and enterprise application development.
2+ years of hands-on experience developing Generative AI, LLM-based, Agentic AI, or AI-assisted business solutions.
Experience building applications and services on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
Experience integrating SAP applications with enterprise AI platforms and approved foundation models.
Experience developing production-grade APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications.
Experience delivering solutions using Agile product delivery methodologies.
Understanding of SAP ERP business processes and enterprise application landscapes.
Interpersonal Skills - leadership, interactions, communication, influence
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate technical concepts to both business and technical stakeholders.
Effective collaboration skills across cross-functional teams.
Ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Other Skills and HPO Competencies
Required Technical Skills
Experience implementing MCP architectures within SAP BTP environments.
Strong understanding of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
Experience with SAP AI Core and SAP AI Foundation.
Experience developing APIs, microservices, and event-driven solutions.
Experience with SAP Integration Suite and integration patterns.
Strong proficiency in Python development.
Hands-on experience with LangChain and LangGraph
Experience designing and implementing Agentic AI solutions and multi-agent systems.
Experience building and deploying MCP (Model Context Protocol) agents and services.
Experience with prompt engineering, LLM evaluations, testing frameworks, and guardrails.
Experience developing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
Familiarity with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and cloud-native development practices.
Understanding of application security, data privacy, and Responsible AI principles.
McCormick & Company is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
As a general policy, McCormick does not offer employment visa sponsorships upon hire or in the future.
WHY WORK AT MCCORMICK
As a McCormick employee you ll be empowered to focus on more than your individual responsibilities. You ll have the opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself-to have a say in where the company is going and how it s growing.
Between our passion for flavor, our 130-year history of leadership and integrity, the competitive and comprehensive benefits we offer, and our culture, which is built on respect and opportunities for growth, there are many reasons to join us at McCormick.
